name: Surgery
boundaries: Surgery: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Master switch for scarless, functional regeneration of complex adult tissues and organs
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by SUR-05 for wounds whose edges are present. Organ-scale replacement is SUR-09 for structural parts and SUR-12 for life-sustaining solid organs. The historical wording joined those problems; the IDs keep them apart.

original_dispositions.original_title: Real-time, cellular-resolution intraoperative imaging for all tissue types
original_dispositions.reason: Added as SUR-11. The historical “zero-miss resection” claim was narrowed. Imaging does not itself delete infiltrative cells, which remains SUR-10.

original_dispositions.original_title: Fully autonomous, error-free robotic surgery with zero supervision
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by SUR-06. The revision does not adopt “error-free” or “zero supervision.” A defined repertoire, prespecified handover, and accountability stay in the concept.

original_dispositions.original_title: Safe, permanent immune tolerance for organ and tissue transplantation
In-vivo 3D bioprinting or directed assembly of functional tissues during surgery
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by SUR-09. Life-sustaining organs built from autologous cells are SUR-12.

original_dispositions.original_title: Non-invasive ablation or repair of deep brain and spinal lesions without craniotomy or laminectomy
original_dispositions.reason: Not added as its own ID. Ablation of selected targets is already clinical: liver histotripsy and incisionless focused-ultrasound thalamotomy, both now cited under SUR-07. Repair of a transected cord or of central visual pathways remains SUR-04. Incisionless reconstruction remains SUR-07. Combining an achieved ablation with an unachieved repair would describe a mixture as if it were one missing discovery.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete functional regeneration of transected peripheral nerves and spinal cord
original_dispositions.reason: The spinal-cord half is covered by SUR-04. The peripheral-nerve half was not added. Repair, graft, transfer, and allograft already restore meaningful function for many nerve injuries. Longer gaps do worse. That is an incremental limit on an existing reconstruction, not a separate field-level principle.

original_dispositions.original_title: Perfect intraoperative hemostasis and blood conservation for any vessel
original_dispositions.reason: Vessel ligation, energy sealing, and transfusion already make blooded surgery possible. Coagulopathic intracavitary bleeding remains a serious clinical problem and an extension of hemorrhage control. It does not create a new operative principle at the calibration used for the retained concepts.

original_dispositions.original_title: Intraoperative gene editing or cell reprogramming
original_dispositions.reason: The central unsolved capability is safe, efficient genome engineering in solid tissue, which is a molecular-therapy advance. Surgery can already deliver local treatments. Residual-cancer killing, if that were the surgical use, would still have to meet the clearance-and-function bar in SUR-10.

original_dispositions.original_title: Patient-specific instant organs grown and implanted in one operative session
original_dispositions.reason: Added as SUR-12. The life-sustaining autologous organ is the revolutionary capability. Same-session growth from a fresh biopsy is recorded as a proposed manufacturing stringency, because a construct matured before implantation would already change supply.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Replaced dependence on the unopened 2026 Nephrology Dialysis Transplantation page with Kawai 2014 and the Wilson 2026 review, which was opened. Added the 15-year follow-up, chimerism-transition syndrome in 9 of 10, the deceased-donor timing barrier, Stanford’s failure in haplotype-mismatched recipients, and the statement that facilitating cells do not eliminate graft-versus-host disease. The concept and the proposed completion are unchanged.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Tolerance is still not established for the transplants most patients receive.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Identity, scope, and proposed completion kept. Author and citation details were filled where the preceding pass had verified them. Current results were not upgraded. Pages that were not re-opened are marked.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Preserve the first-pass concepts and distinguish verified details from sources carried forward.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added the July 2025 SRT-H ex vivo cholecystectomy phase and the July 2026 teleoperated humanoid porcine cholecystectomy. The completion bar was not raised to “error-free” or “zero supervision.”
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Both are real advances in a task or in a platform. Neither is autonomous completion of a whole operation in a living patient.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added MRI-guided focused ultrasound thalamotomy as a second achieved form of incisionless ablation.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical deep-brain item should not be left looking undiscovered. Reconstruction remains the unmet half.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Explicitly pointed the life-sustaining solid-organ consequence to SUR-12, so the structural concept is preserved and the overlap is visible. Added the 2025 vascular-patterning limit.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The structural and life-sustaining solid-organ concepts have different completion scopes.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Noted long-gap peripheral-nerve fidelity as related and outside this ID.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Peripheral-nerve repair has different anatomy and meaningful recovery already exists for many shorter nerve injuries.
Seeing a cell is not deleting it.

Cellular imaging exists as a probe and as a specimen technique. Field-wide vision during dissection does not, and that missing view would change what the surgeon can identify. It was separated from SUR-10 so the historical imaging item is not collapsed into cell killing.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added SUR-12. Same-day assembly is labeled as a stricter manufacturing claim, not as a result.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: A life-sustaining autologous kidney, liver lobe, or heart is a supply and immunology change of the same order as destination xenotransplantation, with a different source and a different failure mode. The first pass had named it and then folded it into SUR-02 and SUR-09. The completion criteria are different enough to keep a separate ID.
